items.title: 10.27 Winkler tareeqa, BOD aur DO (print mein 10.27) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the topic printed as 10.27 with Figure 10.12, printed pages 239-240.

blocks.text: Biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) qudrati pani mein maujood organic madde ki paanch din mein oxygen kharch karne ki salahiyat hai. BOD ki value woh oxygen hai jo namoone (sample) mein ghule hue organic madde ke biological oxidation mein kharch hoti hai. Yeh oxidation pani mein pehle se maujood microorganisms (khurdbeeni jandar) catalyze karte hain. BOD Winkler method se napi jati hai: paanch din ke shuru aur aakhir mein oxygen ki concentration napi jati hai, jabke band (sealed) namoona andhere mein 25°C ke mustaqil temperature par rakha jata hai.

blocks.alt: Darya ke bahao ki simt ke muqable concentration ka graph. Dissolved Oxygen (thos lakeer) ooncha hai, achanak gir kar kam tareen hota hai aur phir aahista dobara ooncha ho jata hai. BOD (nuqta-dar lakeer) neecha hai, usi jagah tezi se chotti tak charhta hai aur phir aahista girta hai, DO ke curve ko kaat-ta hua.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.12: BOD aur DO ka ulta taalluq (kitab ki Figure 10.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jahan darya mein organic madda (maslan ganda pani) milta hai, wahan bacteria use torne ke liye oxygen kharch karte hain: BOD tezi se barhta hai aur DO tezi se girta hai. Aage chal kar organic madda khatam hota hai to BOD ghatta hai aur hawa se oxygen ghulne par DO dobara barh jata hai. Kitab ki figure mein ‘Disolved’ chhapa hai; sahi hijje ‘Dissolved’ hain.

Dissolved oxygen (DO) pani mein ghuli hui oxygen ki miqdar hai. Yeh oxygen ya to hawa (atmosphere) se ghulti hai ya pani ke paude photosynthesis mein chhorte hain. DO ki concentration 5 se 8 mg/dm³ hoti hai. DO kam se kam 5 mg/dm³ honi chahiye; 5 mg/dm³ se kam ho to pani aalooda (polluted) samjha jata hai.
DO aur BOD ka ulta (inverse) taalluq hai, jaisa Figure 10.12 mein hai. Jab bacteria organic madda torte hue pani ki oxygen kharch karte hain to BOD barhta hai aur DO kam ho jata hai.

Winkler method pani ke namoonon mein dissolved oxygen (DO) napne ka tareeqa hai. Is ki bunyad yeh hai ke namoone ki ghuli hui oxygen oxidizing khasiyat rakhti hai aur KI se react kar ke iodine banati hai. Bani hui iodine ko sodium thiosulfate se titrate kar ke napa jata hai; starch indicator solution ko gehra neela (dark blue) karta hai jo endpoint batata hai. Bani hui iodine ki miqdar solution ki dissolved oxygen ke mutanasib (proportional) hai.

blocks.prompt: Zyada BOD wala pani aalooda kyun samjha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada BOD ka matlab pani mein bohat organic madda (ganda pani, kachra) hai jise bacteria torte hue zyada oxygen kharch karte hain. Is se DO 5 mg/dm³ se neeche gir jati hai aur machhliyan aur doosre aabi jandar mar sakte hain.

items: BOD: 5 din mein organic madde ke microbial oxidation mein kharch oxygen (band, andhera, 25°C).
DO: 5 se 8 mg/dm³; 5 se kam = aalooda; BOD aur DO ulte badalte hain.
Winkler: ghuli O₂ KI se iodine banati hai; thiosulfate se titration, starch se gehra neela endpoint.
